archetypes.name: White-Black Zombies
archetypes.plan: Build around Unraveling Mummy: Curve out with Zombies, use embalm or recursion for resilience, and turn Zombie combat into incremental life loss.

archetypes.name: Blue-Red Spells
archetypes.plan: Build around Bloodwater Entity: Cast cheap instants and sorceries to trigger spell payoffs while bounce and burn keep attackers connecting.

archetypes.name: Black-Green -1/-1 Counters
archetypes.plan: Build around Obelisk Spider: Place -1/-1 counters where they create profitable trades, then convert those counters into drain and card advantage.

archetypes.name: Red-White Exert
archetypes.plan: Build around Resolute Survivors: Attack early and exert aggressively, using untap effects and exert rewards to offset the skipped untap step.

archetypes.name: Green-Blue Ramp
archetypes.plan: Build around River Hoopoe: Accelerate and fix mana into large threats, then use late-game card draw to keep presenting finishers.
